examples.title: Complete SQL Audit Workflow
examples.description: End-to-end example showing how to audit SQL generated by an agent during a session

steps.action: Extract SQL observations with jq pipeline

extracted_data.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
import json
import subprocess

with open('/tmp/3b324448bdfe_acc_cybercafe_chipset.sql', 'r') as f:
    sql_query = f.read()

args_json = json.dumps({"sql": sql_query, "format": "markdown"})
cmd = ['mcporter', 'call', 'mb_bu_transaction_db', 'execute_sql', '--args', args_json]
subprocess.run(cmd)
EOF

steps.action: Extract SQL file paths from Python heredoc commands
steps.command: npx langfuse-cli api traces get "trace-4296fd9f-655a" | jq -r '[.observations[] | select((.output.ASSISTANT_OUTPUT.content // []) | any(.type == "toolCall" and .name == "exec")) | .output.ASSISTANT_OUTPUT.content[] | select(.type == "toolCall" and .name == "exec") | .arguments.command | match("/tmp/[^'\"]+\.sql") | .string] | unique[]'
steps.note: This extracts unique SQL file paths from mcporter wrapper commands

steps.expected_output:
SELECT
  accrual_year_month,
  chipset,
  SUM(cybercafe_amount) as total_cybercafe_cn
FROM ads_sales_wac_gross_profit_acc_monthly_di
WHERE accrual_year_month = 202501
GROUP BY accrual_year_month, chipset
ORDER BY total_cybercafe_cn DESC;

examples.title: Quick SQL Path Extraction from mcporter Commands
examples.description: Extract SQL file paths from Python mcporter wrapper commands
examples.command: npx langfuse-cli api traces get "trace-xyz789" | jq -r '[.observations[] | select((.output.ASSISTANT_OUTPUT.content // []) | any(.type == "toolCall" and .name == "exec")) | .output.ASSISTANT_OUTPUT.content[] | select(.type == "toolCall" and .name == "exec") | .arguments.command | match("/tmp/[^'\"]+\.sql") | .string] | unique[]'
examples.note: This regex pattern extracts SQL paths from Python heredoc: with open('/tmp/xxxxx.sql', 'r')

examples.title: Filter by Specific Tool Name
examples.description: Extract observations that used a specific tool (e.g., 'exec', 'run_sql', 'query_db')
examples.command: npx langfuse-cli api traces get "<trace-id>" | jq '[.observations[] | select((.output.ASSISTANT_OUTPUT.content // []) | any(.type == "toolCall" and .name == "exec")) | {id: .id, tool_calls: [.output.ASSISTANT_OUTPUT.content[] | select(.type == "toolCall" and .name == "exec")]}]'
examples.use_case: When you know the exact tool name used for SQL execution

examples.title: Debugging: Show All Thinking Steps
examples.description: Extract only thinking content to understand SQL generation reasoning
examples.command: npx langfuse-cli api traces get "<trace-id>" | jq '[.observations[] | select((.output.ASSISTANT_OUTPUT.content // []) | any(.type == "thinking")) | {node: .name, thinking: [.output.ASSISTANT_OUTPUT.content[] | select(.type == "thinking") | .thinking]}]'
examples.use_case: Audit the reasoning process before SQL was generated

examples.title: Multi-Session Audit
examples.description: Audit SQL across multiple related sessions

steps.action: List all sessions for a time range
steps.command: npx langfuse-cli api traces list --from "2025-05-01" --to "2025-05-31" | jq '.data[] | select(.sessionId != null) | .sessionId' | sort -u

steps.action: Loop through each session and extract SQL
steps.pseudo_code:
for session_id in $(cat session_ids.txt); do
  npx langfuse-cli api traces list --session-id "$session_id" | jq '.data[] | .id' | while read trace_id; do
    npx langfuse-cli api traces get "$trace_id" | jq '<pipeline>'
  done
done
steps.note: Use this pattern for bulk SQL auditing across multiple agent runs

examples.title: Extract SQL from Specific Observation ID
examples.description: When you already know the observation ID containing SQL
examples.command: npx langfuse-cli api observations get "e5c05254-e94f-4058-a801-1dff546cb92f" | jq '.output.ASSISTANT_OUTPUT.content[] | select(.type == "toolCall" and .name == "exec") | .arguments.command | match("/tmp/[^'\"]+\.sql") | .string'
examples.use_case: Direct observation access when ID is known (avoids trace-level filtering)

examples.title: Fallback: Extract SQL Content from Observations (When /tmp Files Cleaned)
examples.description: Extract SQL content directly from 'write' tool calls when temporary files are no longer accessible
examples.scenario: Use this when read_file fails with 'file not found' for /tmp/*.sql files
examples.command: npx langfuse-cli api traces get "<trace-id>" | jq '[.observations[] | select((.output | objects | .ASSISTANT_OUTPUT.content // []) as $c | ($c | any(.type == "thinking")) or ($c | any(.type == "toolCall" and .name == "write"))) | {observation_id: .id, node_name: .name, extracted_data: [(.output.ASSISTANT_OUTPUT.content // [])[] | if .type == "thinking" then {type: .type, value: .thinking} elif (.type == "toolCall" and .name == "write") then {type: .type, tool_name: .name, path: .arguments?.path, sql: .arguments?.content} else empty end]}] | sort_by(.node_name | match("[0-9]+") | .string | tonumber)'

node_ordering.description: Sort observations by node number for chronological view

mcporter_command_detection.note: SQL is executed via: mcporter call <db> execute_sql --args <json>

possible_causes: No observations contain 'thinking' or 'exec' tool calls
SQL execution wrapped in different tool (check tool name)
empty_results.debug_command: npx langfuse-cli api traces get "<trace-id>" | jq '.observations[] | {id: .id, output_keys: .output | keys, tool_names: [.output.ASSISTANT_OUTPUT.content[]? | select(.type == "toolCall") | .name]}'

data_truncated.issue: Large observations get truncated in output
data_truncated.solution: Use the jq pipeline to filter BEFORE retrieving full trace data, or fetch specific observation by ID

jq_parse_error.issue: jq syntax error when running pipeline
jq_parse_error.solution: Ensure single quotes wrap the entire jq expression, use proper escaping for shell

regex_not_matching_sql_paths.issue: SQL file paths not extracted from Python heredoc
possible_causes: Different quote style used (double quotes vs single quotes)
SQL path uses different pattern (not in /tmp/)

multiple_sql_files_in_one_observation.issue: Single observation contains multiple SQL executions
multiple_sql_files_in_one_observation.solution: The jq pipeline already handles this - it extracts ALL toolCall entries
multiple_sql_files_in_one_observation.note: Use 'unique[]' at the end to deduplicate paths if same SQL runs multiple times

tmp_files_cleaned.issue: read_file returns 'file not found' for /tmp/*.sql files
tmp_files_cleaned.cause: Temporary files were cleaned up by system or container restart
tmp_files_cleaned.solution: Use Step 4 Option B: Extract SQL content from 'write' tool calls in observations
tmp_files_cleaned.recovery_command: npx langfuse-cli api traces get "<trace-id>" | jq '[.observations[] | select((.output.ASSISTANT_OUTPUT.content // []) | any(.type == "toolCall" and .name == "write")) | .output.ASSISTANT_OUTPUT.content[] | select(.type == "toolCall" and .name == "write") | {path: .arguments?.path, sql: .arguments?.content}]'
tmp_files_cleaned.note: SQL content is permanently stored in Langfuse observations, independent of /tmp filesystem
